findings.title: Raw SQL query uses string interpolation with unvalidated search query parameter

evidence.code: public async Task<ActionResult<List<Order>>> SearchLegacy([FromQuery] string query)
var rawSql = $"SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE Description LIKE '%{query}%'";
evidence.why: string interpolation directly constructs SQL statement
sink: raw SQL execution without parameter binding

findings.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated caller provides a crafted query parameter to escape the LIKE string literal and inject arbitrary SQL clauses or statements.
findings.impact: Arbitrary SQL execution against the underlying database, allowing an attacker to read, modify, or delete orders across all tenants.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with FromSqlInterpolated or bind parameters through FormattableString rather than passing interpolated strings to FromSqlRaw.
findings.fix_example: var results = await _dbContext.Orders.FromSqlInterpolated($"SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE Description LIKE {'%' + query + '%'}").ToListAsync();

findings.title: Native SQL query interpolates unvalidated search query parameter

evidence.code: val sql = "SELECT * FROM portal_orders WHERE description LIKE '%$query%'"
evidence.why: string template interpolation directly into SQL string
sink: native query execution without parameter binding

findings.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated caller provides a crafted query parameter containing SQL syntax to break out of the LIKE pattern and manipulate the query structure.
findings.impact: Arbitrary SQL execution in the database, allowing an attacker to read or manipulate records across all tenants.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with named or positional parameters via Query.setParameter instead of string interpolation.
findings.fix_example: val queryResult = entityManager.createNativeQuery("SELECT * FROM portal_orders WHERE description LIKE :query", OrderEntity::class.java).setParameter("query", "%$query%").resultList
